simple.meaning: עָנָה (ʻânâh) appears 329 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line and in connection with flocks.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 3 more, beginning at Genesis 18:27. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, righteousness, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָנָה (H6030) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows עָנָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: עָנָה (ʻânâh) / H6030 is tracked through Genesis 18:27, Genesis 23:5, Genesis 23:10, Genesis 23:14. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.short: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed , i.e. pay attention ; by implication, to respond ; by extension to begin to speak ; specifically to sing , shout , testify , announce
definitions.usage: give account, afflict (by mistake for 6031 ), (cause to, give) answer, bring low (by mistake for 6031 ), cry, hear, Leannoth, lift up, say, × scholar, (give a) shout, sing (together by course), speak, testify, utter, (bear) witness. See also 1042 , 1043 .
